purpose: Confirm source taxonomy/coordinate alignment and annotation limitations before training; not independent full relabelling or a grade-validation study.
rdd_notes: Four official source codes align to the intended defect categories in the reviewed boxes.
Some D40 rectangles cover broad repaired/distressed regions and tiny distant marks; a source pothole label does not measure depth.
Some cracks/joints have ambiguous material/context; do not infer severity, surface type or healthy-road negatives.
roi_notes: Class 0 fills the annotated road region, class 2 source footpath, class 3 shallow areas.
Outside annotated regions are encoded 255; no source ID=1 pixels occur in the full corpus.
Masks are coarse semantic polygons; individual defects, obscured pavement and physical geometry are not independently verified.
